answer: A new agent identity must post a minimum stake before it can transact, held in escrow and slashable on misbehaviour. A Sybil attacker wanting ten thousand identities funds ten thousand separate deposits, each frozen and revocable. The reputation graph is a trellis that lifts only accounts with real counterparties, since attestations among freshly minted wallets form a closed loop no honest client credits. Above that sits a basalt layer of per-epoch quotas, so a swarm costs linear capital plus real time. A wide mesa of cheap accounts is no bargain when each square metre must be paid.
